messages:
Marta: Quick handoff — leaving notes before I sign off. Observed encoder pool 99th latency jitter ~19:10-19:40 UTC (up ~30ms), js-preprocessor retries spiked in eu-central around 19:20, and kv-prefetch WARN alerts flapping. No customer-facing errors. Handing coverage to Sam overnight. :wave:

Alex: Thanks. Any recent infra changes or deploys that could match?

Marta: No deploys to encoder/prefetch today after noon. We did tweak decoder batching at 15:45 but timing doesn't line up.

Jin: I'll check node metrics. One host showed higher soft interrupts at 19:18 — grabbing logs now.

Marta: quick queries I ran:
```
# 99th encoder latency per pod
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(encoder_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pod))

# retries for js-preprocessor last 1h
increase(request_retries_total{route="js-preprocessor"}[1h])
```

Marta: Numbers:
- encoder 99th: ~210ms -> ~240ms for 30m
- js-preprocessor retries: +32 in 30m from eu-central-1
- kv-prefetch alert: flapping at WARN threshold, median latency fine

Sam: I got this handoff. I'll watch eu-central, encoder pool, and prefetch silences. @Jin drop the logs link please.

Jin: logs: https://logs.internal/replay/enc-node-07/2026-03-16-19-00
Note: kernel showed an NVMe remap event at 19:16, then recovered.

Marta: Action items:
- Sam: monitor encoder 99th and js-preprocessor retry rate; escalate if retries > 50 in 30m.
- Alex: run encoder node health check in eu-central: `./scripts/health-check --role encoder --region eu-central`
- Jin: follow up on NVMe remap and check SMART counters.

Alex: Running health-check now. I'll post results.

RotationBot: Reminder: oncall rotation swap at 06:00 UTC tomorrow (Sam -> Alex). :bell:

Alex: health-check returned minor disk soft errors on enc-node-07 (SMART attribute increased), CPU/mem normal. No immediate action but FYI.

Sam: I'll set a temporary silence for the kv-prefetch WARN noise to reduce alerts; critical thresholds remain. If retries continue to rise I'll notify.

Marta: Note: Optimize lowered encoder batch target earlier to reduce tail variance — throughput may dip slightly.

Sam: Thanks. I'll capture any trends in the handoff doc and ping if anything degrades. Good handoff, cheers :thumbsup:

Marta: Signing off. If anything pops up wake me.

Participants: Marta, Alex, Sam, Jin, RotationBot
